A translucent green water tank is visible near the front. The soleplate appears metallic but is partially obscured by shadow and angle. A power cord extends from the rear right. There is text/branding on the side of the white body.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The translucent green plastic lacks realistic internal refraction or thickness variation; it appears as a flat, semi-transparent overlay rather than a solid 3D volume containing liquid.
The text on the lower white body is illegible and morphologically inconsistent, resembling AI-generated pseudo-text rather than crisp manufacturing labels.
The junction where the blue handle meets the white body at the rear is slightly soft and ill-defined, lacking a sharp mechanical seam.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of iron and rule out misclassification as similar appliances (e.g., steamer).
To verify if the translucent green tank has valid 3D depth and refractive properties, or if it is a flat texture artifact.
To analyze the illegible text for character-level coherence and detect AI text generation artifacts.
To assess global sharpness, lighting consistency, and subtle blending errors between the blue and white plastic components.

focus_areas: Translucency and refraction logic of the green water tank
Legibility and structure of the printed brand text
Sharpness of boundaries between different colored plastic parts
Physical plausibility of the power cord attachment point
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'green tank' region. AI often fails to render translucent materials correctly, resulting in flat colors or impossible geometry. Also, scrutinize the text on the side; if it is gibberish, it is a strong indicator of generative origin despite the otherwise clean look.
